text:
jess_support: opening — ACME reports responses after v10b are noticeably more concise and sometimes leave out follow-up clarifying sentences. They sent side-by-side examples and asked us to investigate. :thinking:

elena_acme: repro examples below. BEFORE (redwood-v10a):
"Sure — here’s an example walkthrough of the flow. First do X, then Y. If you have constraints Z, try variant A. Do you want an abbreviated version?"

AFTER (redwood-v10b):
"Do X, then Y."

elena_acme: they say this affects helpdesk replies and makes answers less helpful; token counts around the same.

jess_support: tagging eng-ml for triage — any initial thoughts on whether this is rollout-related or param drift?

raj_eng_ml: can you paste the exact API call (model, params, prompt) and any request_ids? also: streaming vs non-streaming, temperature/top_p, stop sequences?

jess_support: copying the curl from the customer + request ids below.

```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v10b","prompt":"<customer prompt here>","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":150,"stream":false}'
```

Request IDs: r-9347f2a1, r-9347f2b9

mira_prod: FYI rollout timeline — v10b ramped to 100% ~3h ago. Canary 10% -> 100% between 2026-03-16T17:45Z and 2026-03-16T18:10Z.

deploy-bot: rollout v10b: start=2026-03-16T17:45Z, end=2026-03-16T18:10Z, canary=10% -> 100%.

raj_eng_ml: I'll replay the exact request against v10a and v10b in an isolated env and diff outputs and tokenization. If it's model-level, we may need a quick prompt-conditioning patch or revert.

raj_eng_ml: created INF-4021 and attached examples + logs (r-9347f2a1, r-9347f2b9). assigning to @raj_eng_ml and @mira_prod. ETA for initial findings: 2-4 hours.

jess_support: customer notes they're escalating internally and asked for rollback contingency if we can't provide an explanation/fix quickly.

mira_prod: noted. if we confirm behavioral regression we can prepare a targeted rollback for orgs affected while we iterate.

jess_support: thanks — I’ll update ACME with the ticket and examples.
